nodes.description: The fast-path QPainter::drawImage() call draws the first RGB tile even though the tile's initialized prefix is smaller than the tile byte span on the crashing path.

edges.description: The same first-tile QImage backing store left underinitialized on the offset == 0 success path is the backing store later handed to QPainter::drawImage().

root_cause_criterion.description: When loadLevel takes the offset == 0 success path for a non-empty tile grid, the bytes of the first tile that mergeLayerIntoImage will hand to QPainter::drawImage() must already be initialized before returning true. The vulnerable code returns immediately; the real fix fills every allocated tile with Qt::transparent before the same return.
